assertion.statement: The authorized source record concerns a New South Wales Government Information (Public Access) matter.
assertion.evidence_window: captured request-page text only; source URL, archive timestamp, and provenance metadata establish identity but cannot alone support a label

labels.positive_rule: Use only when the captured text explicitly names the GIPA Act or Government Information (Public Access) as the governing NSW information-access matter.
labels.negative_rule: Do not use for an agency name, NSW location, request-page layout, attachment listing, FOI legacy label, or generic information-access phrase alone.

labels.positive_rule: Use only when explicit text facts mechanically establish the NSW GIPA matter and the derivation is recorded.
labels.negative_rule: Do not use for legal interpretation, agency-name inference, or ambiguous historical terminology.

labels.positive_rule: Use when the text supports a possible NSW GIPA mapping but lacks an explicit governing-act statement or has unresolved temporal/regime evidence.
labels.negative_rule: Do not use when the text is unreadable or provides no NSW/GIPA-relevant evidence.

labels.positive_rule: Use when the supplied text cannot decide the assertion.
labels.negative_rule: Do not use as an implicit negative or merely because span selection is difficult.

span_policy.boundary_rule: select the shortest contiguous span containing the governing-act phrase and its immediate request context; do not include signatures, navigation, attachment lists, or unrelated correspondence
span_policy.multiple_span_rule: one span unless two non-contiguous explicit facts are necessary; never use a whole-document span

abstention.rule: abstention=true requires reason and label=unknown; abstention=false requires a label and valid span unless label=unknown
